answer: Make every identity post a small refundable stake, slashed when a grading jury catches copied or fabricated work. One honest agent stakes once and earns it back; an attacker spawning a thousand fake identities must lock a thousand stakes and loses each one that gets caught. The attacker's cost scales linearly with the size of the attack while the honest network's cost stays flat — identity creation stops being free. Like a zenith reached only by climbing, or marble quarried block by block, the signal of honest work is expensive to fake and cheap to verify.
